source_clause: NOPR2.1) Selecting “X” on the default Welcome popup will lead to another popup with options of “Remind me Later” and “Don’t Show me Again”. Selecting “Remind me Later” will close the popup until the next time that Profile is activated. Clicking outside the Welcome popup will close the popup without asking “Remind me Later” and “Don’t Show me Again”.
leaf_desc_037: Selecting “X” on the default Welcome popup will lead to another popup with options of “Remind me Later” and “Don’t Show me Again”. Clicking outside the Welcome popup will close the popup without asking “Remind me Later” and “Don’t Show me Again”.
reasoning: 驗證目標：6.3.1（NOPR2.1）末句 —— 點擊 popup 外部直接關閉，不出現 Remind me Later／Don’t Show me Again 之詢問。關鍵情境條件：Welcome popup 須在顯示中。為什麼這樣切：本條為**負向形態之斷言**，其判定不依賴二次 popup 之內容，故不因 RD 之 label 答覆而變（J-7）。

tcs.tc_title: Clicking outside closes the popup without asking
tcs.test_item:
Clicking outside closes the popup without asking

(Verifies that clicking outside the Welcome popup closes it without asking Remind me Later or Don't Show me Again)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The Welcome popup of the active Profile is displayed
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the screen outside the Welcome popup
2. Read the screen and check which popups are displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Welcome popup is closed
2. No popup offering Remind me Later and Don’t Show me Again is displayed
tcs.priority_basis: 點擊外部關閉且不再詢問
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: **ER2 為缺席斷言** —— 條文之 `without asking` 只能以「那個 popup 沒有出現」證之。與 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-050-01` 同節不同分支：按 X 與點擊外部之結果**相反**（一個問、一個不問），故 037 切為兩個 leaf，本條不與其併。
